preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'CHEF' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S contains only characters from the set {'C', 'H', 'E', 'F'}.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of moves Chef can make.
